# Portable distance fixtures

`riemann-distance-fixtures.rds` contains deterministic input arrays and three
reference distances generated by Riemann 0.1.7 in a separate R session. It does
not contain executable callbacks or tensor pointers. The development generator
and environment record are in `development/reference-oracles` in the repository.
This released-package comparison is distinct from the pinned source audit.
No Riemann dependency is needed to run the installed tests or numerical code.
